k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-6.seo_p1: The K Pipe PPR SDR 6 is a high-performance pipe from our comprehensive pipe system category. It is designed to handle demanding fluid transport safely and efficiently.
k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-6.seo_p2: This pipe is made of durable PPR material and is designed with the SDR 6 (Series S 2.5) rating for a high operating pressure of up to 2.0 MPa at 20°C. The standard length of 4 metres allows for quick installation.
k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-6.seo_p3: Thanks to its excellent chemical and thermal resistance, the SDR 6 pipe is ideal for industrial applications and drinking water supply. The smooth inner surface minimises pressure loss and prevents scaling.

faq.q: For which operating temperatures is SDR 6 suitable?
faq.a: It is designed for continuous operating temperatures up to 70°C and offers a compressive strength of 20 bar at 20°C.

faq.q: What are the advantages of the high wall thickness?
faq.a: The SDR 6 (S 2.5) series offers maximum pressure resistance and mechanical stability in highly stressed systems.

faq.q: Can I use this pipe for cold water?
faq.a: Yes, it is excellent for cold water systems as the smooth surface effectively prevents incrustations and bacterial growth.

k-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p1: The K Pipe PPRCT SDR 7.4 represents the next generation of plastic pipe systems. It combines improved material properties with an optimised wall thickness for maximum flow rates.
k-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p2: Made of highly crystalline PPRCT, this pipe offers an impressive nominal pressure of 2.0 MPa at 20°C at SDR 7.4 (S 3.2). The reduced wall thickness saves weight without compromising stability.
k-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p3: Typical applications include complex heating, air conditioning, and sanitary systems. With the PPRCT material, installers benefit from higher long-term strength even at elevated temperatures.

faq.q: What does PPRCT mean compared to PPR?
faq.a: PPRCT stands for an improved crystalline structure that allows higher pressures at higher temperatures, enabling thinner wall thicknesses.

faq.q: Is the flow rate higher with SDR 7.4?
faq.a: Yes, due to the reduced wall thickness of PPRCT, up to 17% higher flow capacity is achieved with the same outer diameter.

faq.q: Is SDR 7.4 suitable for heating systems?
faq.a: Absolutely, the material is extremely thermally resistant and therefore ideal for flow lines in modern heating systems.

k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p1: The K-Pipe PP-R SDR 11 is the standard solution for a variety of sanitary and heating applications. It is characterised by its reliability and easy handling.
k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p2: With an SDR 11 classification (Series S 5), this PP-R pipe is certified for an operating pressure of 1.2 MPa at 20°C. The 4-metre lengths can be welded flexibly and precisely.
k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p3: It is frequently used in cold water distribution and as a versatile pipe in building services. The homogeneous welded joint guarantees a lifelong seal without mechanical weak points.

faq.q: Is the pipe suitable for hot and cold water?
faq.a: The SDR 11 pipe is primarily designed for cold water (20°C at 12 bar) and the low-pressure hot water range (60°C at 6 bar).

faq.q: How is the PP-R SDR 11 pipe installed?
faq.a: Installation is carried out using the socket fusion welding process, creating absolutely homogeneous, leak-free connections.

faq.q: Are there weight differences compared to other SDR classes?
faq.a: Yes, due to the lower wall thickness, the pipe is significantly lighter and more flexible to handle on site.

k-pipe-purple-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p1: The purple-coloured K-Pipe Purple PP-R SDR 11 is used for the clear identification of specific piping systems. It prevents confusion during the installation of separate water circuits.
k-pipe-purple-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p2: The purple signal colour typically identifies process water, rainwater, or irrigation systems. Technically, it corresponds to the standard PP-R with SDR 11 (1.2 MPa at 20°C) and offers the same high quality.
k-pipe-purple-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p3: Using this special pipe increases system safety and visually ensures the standard-compliant separation of drinking and non-potable water. Perfect for sustainable water management systems.

faq.q: What does the purple colour indicate?
faq.a: It serves to visually distinguish piping systems for process water, greywater, or rainwater harvesting according to international guidelines.

faq.q: Can the pipe be welded with normal PP-R fittings?
faq.a: Yes, the purple pipe is compatible with all K Aqua standard fittings and is welded with the same parameters.

faq.q: Does the colour affect the quality of the material?
faq.a: No, the physical and chemical properties are identical to the regular PP-R SDR 11 pipe.

k-fiber-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p1: The K-Fiber Pipe PPRCT SDR 7.4 is a state-of-the-art, fibre-reinforced composite pipe. The integrated fibre layer significantly reduces linear expansion.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p2: The innovative PPRCT base is complemented by a fibre middle layer. With SDR 7.4 (S 3.2), the pipe withstands pressures of up to 2.0 MPa at 20°C, while offering up to 50% less thermal expansion.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p3: This makes the pipe the perfect choice for risers and long runs in building services, where fewer fastening points are required, saving installation time and material costs.

faq.q: How much does the fibre reduce thermal linear expansion?
faq.a: The integrated fibreglass layer reduces linear expansion by up to 75% compared to solid PP-R pipes.

faq.q: Does the fibre pipe need to be peeled before welding?
faq.a: No, unlike Stabi pipes with an aluminium layer, our fibre pipe can be welded directly without pretreatment.

faq.q: Is the pipe suitable for central risers?
faq.a: Yes, due to its extremely high intrinsic stiffness and pressure resistance, it is the optimal choice for large risers.

k-fiberclima-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-11.seo_p1: The K-FiberClima Pipe PPRCT SDR 11 was specially developed for demanding climate control and cooling applications. It combines high thermal stability with minimal linear expansion.
k-fiberclima-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-11.seo_p2: Based on advanced PPRCT and reinforced with a robust fibre layer, this SDR 11 pipe offers a reliable operating pressure of 1.2 MPa at 20°C. Its structure effectively reduces condensation risks.
k-fiberclima-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-11.seo_p3: Ideal for chilled water networks and industrial cooling circuits, the K-FiberClima pipe guarantees efficient heat transfer and long-term durability in continuous operation.

faq.q: Why is this pipe ideal for air conditioning?
faq.a: It offers low thermal conductivity and high resistance to temperature fluctuations, which increases the efficiency of chilled water networks.

faq.q: Does it require external insulation?
faq.a: Although its intrinsic insulation is high, external insulation may still be required depending on the ambient conditions to completely prevent condensation.

faq.q: Can it be used in industrial cooling?
faq.a: Yes, the robust PPRCT and fibre composite can easily withstand the demands of industrial cooling circuits.

k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p1: The K-Fiber Pipe PP-R SDR 7.4 is a highly stable composite pipe that unites the proven properties of PP-R with advanced fibre technology.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p2: With an SDR 7.4 (S 3.2) rating, it is designed for a pressure of 2.0 MPa at 20°C. The fibreglass middle layer ensures exceptional form stability and reduced thermal expansion.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p3: It is preferred in high-temperature heating systems and industrial plants where mechanical rigidity and reliable performance under pressure are crucial.

faq.q: What is the main benefit of the fibre layer here?
faq.a: It drastically reduces thermal expansion, meaning fewer expansion loops and supports are needed during installation.

faq.q: Is it suitable for high-temperature applications?
faq.a: Yes, it is designed for high-temperature continuous operation, making it ideal for heating distribution networks.

faq.q: How does it compare to standard PP-R?
faq.a: It offers greater stiffness and significantly less elongation when subjected to heat compared to non-reinforced PP-R.

k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-9.seo_p1: The K-Fiber Pipe PP-R SDR 9 offers an optimal balance between high pressure resistance and improved flow characteristics, enhanced by fibre reinforcement.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-9.seo_p2: Designed for a nominal pressure of 1.6 MPa at 20°C, this SDR 9 (S 4) pipe provides excellent mechanical stability thanks to its fibreglass core.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-9.seo_p3: It is widely used in medium-pressure applications, such as district heating connections and extensive plumbing networks, ensuring long-lasting, leak-free operation.

faq.q: When should I choose SDR 9 over SDR 7.4?
faq.a: SDR 9 is ideal when you need higher flow rates than SDR 7.4 but more pressure resistance than SDR 11.

faq.q: Does the fibre core affect water quality?
faq.a: No, the fibre layer is completely encapsulated in PP-R, so it never comes into contact with the fluid.

faq.q: Is this pipe easy to weld?
faq.a: Yes, it welds exactly like standard PP-R pipes using standard socket fusion tools.

k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p1: The K-Fiber Pipe PP-R SDR 11 is the perfect solution for standard plumbing and heating installations requiring reduced thermal expansion.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p2: This SDR 11 (S 5) pipe combines the standard 1.2 MPa (at 20°C) pressure rating with a fibreglass middle layer, resulting in a lightweight yet highly stable pipe.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p3: It is the go-to choice for surface-mounted installations and risers where straight, sag-free pipe runs are aesthetically and technically required.

faq.q: Is this pipe suitable for exposed installations?
faq.a: Yes, its high stiffness prevents sagging, making it ideal for visible installations where neatness is important.

faq.q: Can it be used for drinking water?
faq.a: Absolutely, it meets all hygiene standards for potable water while offering structural benefits.

faq.q: How does the weight compare to metal pipes?
faq.a: It is a fraction of the weight of steel or copper pipes, making transportation and installation much easier.

k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-17.seo_p1: The K-Fiber Pipe PP-R SDR 17 is specifically engineered for high-volume, low-pressure applications where maximum flow and minimal expansion are needed.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-17.seo_p2: With its thin-walled SDR 17 (S 8) design, it offers a pressure rating of 0.6 MPa at 20°C. The fibre reinforcement maintains pipe rigidity despite the thin walls.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-17.seo_p3: It is excellently suited for large-scale cooling water systems, chilled water distribution, and agricultural applications where large volumes of water are transported at lower pressures.

faq.q: What is the primary use case for SDR 17?
faq.a: It is mainly used for low-pressure, high-volume fluid transport, such as cooling circuits and large-scale water distribution.

faq.q: Is the fibre reinforcement necessary for such thin walls?
faq.a: Yes, the fibre layer provides essential structural integrity and prevents sagging in these large-diameter, thin-walled pipes.

faq.q: Can this be used for hot water?
faq.a: It is generally not recommended for high-temperature hot water due to its lower pressure rating; it is optimized for cold and ambient fluids.

k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p1: The K-Fiber UV Pipe PP-R SDR 7.4 is a highly stable composite pipe featuring a specialized outer layer for maximum UV resistance.
k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p2: Designed for a nominal pressure of 2.0 MPa at 20°C (SDR 7.4 / S 3.2), this pipe combines the structural stability of fibreglass reinforcement with robust protection against sunlight.
k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p3: It is the ideal solution for outdoor installations, exposed risers, and rooftop cooling systems, where continuous UV exposure would otherwise degrade standard PP-R pipes.

faq.q: Why do I need a UV-resistant pipe?
faq.a: Standard PP-R can degrade and become brittle under prolonged exposure to direct sunlight. The UV layer prevents this degradation completely.

faq.q: Does the UV layer affect the welding process?
faq.a: Depending on the outer layer, minimal surface peeling may be required to ensure a homogeneous weld, but the core PP-R welds perfectly.

faq.q: Can it be used indoors as well?
faq.a: Yes, although it is optimized for outdoor use, its high structural stability makes it perfectly suitable for indoor applications.

k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p1: The K-Fiber UV Pipe PPRCT SDR 7.4 represents the pinnacle of outdoor piping technology, combining advanced PPRCT, fibre reinforcement, and UV protection.
k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p2: Offering an operating pressure of 2.0 MPa at 20°C, this SDR 7.4 (S 3.2) pipe provides exceptional flow capacity, low thermal expansion, and total immunity to UV radiation.
k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p3: This is the ultimate pipe for demanding outdoor industrial applications, solar thermal systems, and external district heating networks where performance cannot be compromised.

faq.q: What makes this pipe different from the standard UV pipe?
faq.a: It utilizes PPRCT instead of standard PP-R, which allows for higher pressure resistance at elevated temperatures.

faq.q: Is the UV layer co-extruded?
faq.a: Yes, the UV-resistant outer layer is co-extruded, meaning it is permanently bonded to the pipe and won't flake off.

faq.q: Does it have the same low expansion as indoor fibre pipes?
faq.a: Yes, the integrated fibreglass layer reduces thermal expansion by up to 75%, which is crucial for long outdoor runs subjected to temperature swings.

cap.seo_p1: The K-Aqua End Cap is a vital PP-R fitting designed to securely and permanently seal the ends of piping systems.
cap.seo_p2: Manufactured with precision, it ensures a 100% leak-proof termination of pipe runs, maintaining the system's full pressure rating (up to PN25).
cap.seo_p3: Ideal for capping off future expansion points or permanently closing branch lines in both drinking water and heating installations.

faq.q: How is the cap installed?
faq.a: It is installed using standard socket fusion welding, creating a permanent, homogeneous seal.

faq.q: Can the cap be removed later for system expansion?
faq.a: Because it forms a permanent weld, expanding the system requires cutting the pipe behind the cap and welding a new fitting.

faq.q: Is it suitable for high-pressure testing?
faq.a: Yes, the cap withstands the maximum test pressures of the K-Aqua system without risk of failure.

socket.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Socket is an essential PP-R fitting used for the straight connection of two pipes of the same diameter.
socket.seo_p2: Engineered for optimal flow, this fitting is socket-fused to the pipes, ensuring a seamless, leak-free joint that is as strong as the pipe itself.
socket.seo_p3: Whether extending long pipe runs in commercial buildings or completing residential installations, the socket is a fundamental component of every K-Aqua system.

faq.q: Does the socket restrict water flow?
faq.a: No, the internal design of the socket ensures that the internal diameter is maintained, minimizing pressure drop.

faq.q: What is the pressure rating of the socket?
faq.a: K-Aqua sockets are rated for PN25, matching or exceeding the pressure resistance of the connected pipes.

faq.q: How long does the socket fusion take?
faq.a: Depending on the pipe dimension, the heating and fusion process takes only a few seconds, with full strength achieved upon cooling.

elbow-45.seo_p1: The K-Aqua 45° Elbow is designed to facilitate smooth directional changes in PP-R piping networks, minimizing flow resistance.
elbow-45.seo_p2: This fitting allows for a 45-degree turn, providing flexibility in routing pipes around obstacles while maintaining the system's high pressure rating.
elbow-45.seo_p3: It is widely used in complex installations, such as plant rooms and distribution manifolds, where precise pipe routing and optimal hydrodynamics are required.

faq.q: Why use a 45° elbow instead of a 90° elbow?
faq.a: A 45° elbow creates less flow resistance and pressure drop than a 90° elbow, which is beneficial in high-flow applications.

faq.q: Is the 45° elbow suitable for hot and cold water?
faq.a: Yes, it is made from premium PP-R and is fully suitable for both hot and cold potable water, as well as heating systems.

faq.q: How do I ensure correct alignment during welding?
faq.a: The fittings feature alignment marks to help installers achieve precise angles during the fusion process.

elbow-45-femalemale.seo_p1: The K-Aqua 45° Female/Male Elbow (Street Elbow) is a space-saving fitting that connects directly to another fitting on one side and a pipe on the other.
elbow-45-femalemale.seo_p2: This design eliminates the need for an intermediate short piece of pipe, saving both installation time and space in tight environments.
elbow-45-femalemale.seo_p3: It is extremely useful in compact plant rooms, manifolds, and confined wall cavities where traditional pipe-to-fitting connections are too bulky.

faq.q: What does 'Female/Male' mean?
faq.a: One end has a female socket to receive a pipe, while the other end has a male spigot that fits directly into the socket of another fitting.

faq.q: Can it handle the same pressure as a standard elbow?
faq.a: Yes, despite its compact design, it is fully rated for PN25 and maintains the integrity of the K-Aqua system.

faq.q: Is special tooling required?
faq.a: No, standard socket fusion tools are used, though extra care is needed when welding the male end into another fitting.

elbow-90.seo_p1: The K-Aqua 90° Elbow is the standard fitting for making sharp, 90-degree directional changes in any PP-R piping system.
elbow-90.seo_p2: Engineered with a smooth internal radius, it minimizes turbulence and pressure loss while navigating corners and tight spaces.
elbow-90.seo_p3: This is one of the most frequently used fittings in residential, commercial, and industrial plumbing, essential for framing pipes along walls and floors.

faq.q: Does a 90° elbow cause significant pressure loss?
faq.a: While it causes more resistance than a straight pipe or a 45° elbow, K-Aqua's optimized internal geometry minimizes this effect compared to standard fittings.

faq.q: Is it guaranteed not to leak?
faq.a: When correctly socket-fused, the elbow and the pipe become one homogeneous piece of plastic, guaranteeing 100% leak-free performance.

faq.q: Are 90° elbows available in all sizes?
faq.a: Yes, they are available in the full range of dimensions to match our entire pipe catalog.

elbow-90-femalemale.seo_p1: The K-Aqua 90° Female/Male Elbow offers a compact 90-degree turn by allowing a direct connection into another fitting's socket.
elbow-90-femalemale.seo_p2: Like its 45-degree counterpart, this 'street elbow' saves critical space and reduces the number of weld joints by eliminating a pipe nipple.
elbow-90-femalemale.seo_p3: It is highly recommended for prefabricated manifolds, compact equipment connections, and tight installation shafts.

faq.q: How does this save installation time?
faq.a: By removing the need to cut and weld a short bridging pipe, you eliminate one complete welding step per connection.

faq.q: Can I chain multiple Female/Male elbows together?
faq.a: Yes, you can connect the male end of one directly into the female end of another to create complex, tight offsets.

faq.q: Is the male end the same outer diameter as the pipe?
faq.a: Yes, the male end is dimensioned exactly like standard K-Aqua pipe to ensure perfect fusion.

electrofusion-socket.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Electrofusion Socket provides an advanced, automated welding solution for PP-R pipes, particularly in large dimensions or tight spaces.
electrofusion-socket.seo_p2: Embedded with internal heating coils, this socket melts the pipe and fitting together when an electrical current is applied via a specialized welding machine.
electrofusion-socket.seo_p3: This technique is indispensable for repairs in confined spaces where traditional welding tools cannot fit, and for ensuring highly consistent welds in large industrial pipelines.

faq.q: When should I use electrofusion instead of socket fusion?
faq.a: Electrofusion is ideal for difficult-to-reach areas, repair work on fixed pipes, and for very large diameters where manual handling is difficult.

faq.q: Do I need a special machine for this?
faq.a: Yes, an electrofusion welding machine is required to supply the precise voltage and time needed to melt the internal coils.

faq.q: Is the joint as strong as manual socket fusion?
faq.a: Yes, electrofusion creates a fully homogeneous, highly reliable joint that meets all PN25 pressure requirements.

flange-adaptor.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Flange Adaptor allows for a robust, demountable connection between the PP-R piping system and flanged metal components like valves or pumps.
flange-adaptor.seo_p2: This fitting is welded to the PP-R pipe and then bolted to a corresponding metal flange, using a backing ring and gasket to ensure a watertight seal.
flange-adaptor.seo_p3: It is essential for integrating industrial equipment, large-scale water meters, and circulating pumps into the K-Aqua plastic piping network.

faq.q: What additional parts are needed for installation?
faq.a: You will need a backing flange (usually steel or coated), a suitable gasket (e.g., EPDM), and bolts/nuts.

faq.q: Can the flange connection withstand high pressure?
faq.a: Yes, when properly bolted with the correct gasket, it withstands the system's maximum operating pressure.

faq.q: Is this connection permanent?
faq.a: No, the advantage of a flange connection is that it can be unbolted for maintenance or equipment replacement.

reducing-bush.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Reducing Bush is a compact fitting designed to step down the pipe diameter within the socket of another fitting.
reducing-bush.seo_p2: This space-efficient design allows a smaller pipe to be connected directly into a larger fitting, such as a tee or an elbow, without a separate reducing socket.
reducing-bush.seo_p3: It ensures smooth flow transitions and is perfect for creating complex, compact distribution manifolds in both heating and water systems.

faq.q: How does a reducing bush differ from a reducing socket?
faq.a: A reducing bush fits *inside* a larger fitting and accepts a smaller pipe, whereas a reducing socket connects a large pipe directly to a small pipe.

faq.q: Does the reduction cause turbulence?
faq.a: K-Aqua reducing bushes are internally chamfered to ensure a smooth hydrodynamic transition, minimizing turbulence.

faq.q: Can multiple bushes be stacked?
faq.a: While possible, it is usually better practice to use the correctly sized single reduction to maintain optimal flow and strength.

reducing-tee.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Reducing Tee enables a branch line to be taken off a main pipe run where the branch is a smaller diameter than the main line.
reducing-tee.seo_p2: This one-piece fitting eliminates the need for a standard tee and a separate reducer, reducing weld joints and potential failure points.
reducing-tee.seo_p3: It is the standard solution for distributing water from a main riser to individual floors or from a main distribution line to individual fixtures.

faq.q: Are the two main run ends the same size?
faq.a: Yes, in a standard reducing tee, the straight run maintains the main pipe diameter, while the 90-degree branch is reduced.

faq.q: Can it be used in reverse (branching a larger pipe off a smaller run)?
faq.a: No, reducing tees are designed specifically to branch down to a smaller diameter, matching natural flow dynamics.

faq.q: Is the pressure rating affected by the reduction?
faq.a: No, the entire fitting, including the reduced branch, is rated for the full system pressure (PN25).

reducing-tee-large-sizes.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Reducing Tee for Large Sizes is engineered for industrial main lines and high-capacity risers, branching off to smaller distribution networks.
reducing-tee-large-sizes.seo_p2: Manufactured with massive wall thicknesses, these large-scale fittings handle immense volumetric flows and high pressures safely and reliably.
reducing-tee-large-sizes.seo_p3: They are critical components in district heating, large cooling circuits, and the central water supply of high-rise buildings and hospitals.

faq.q: How are these large tees installed?
faq.a: Large sizes often require butt welding or the use of electrofusion sockets, depending on the specific dimension and site conditions.

faq.q: Are they as strong as smaller fittings?
faq.a: Absolutely. They are engineered with proportionally thicker walls to guarantee the same PN rating across the entire size range.

faq.q: Do they cause high pressure drops in the main line?
faq.a: No, the internal geometry is hydrodynamically optimized to ensure the main flow passes through with minimal resistance.

tee.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Equal Tee is a fundamental fitting used to split or combine fluid flow at a 90-degree angle, with all three ends having the same diameter.
tee.seo_p2: Designed for maximum structural integrity and optimal flow division, this fitting ensures reliable distribution in any PP-R piping network.
tee.seo_p3: From simple household plumbing to complex industrial grids, the equal tee is indispensable for creating robust, leak-free branch connections.

faq.q: Does an equal tee divide the flow exactly 50/50?
faq.a: The flow division depends on the downstream resistance in each branch, but the fitting itself is symmetrical.

faq.q: Can it be used to combine two flows into one?
faq.a: Yes, tees work in both directions, though combining flows can create turbulence depending on velocities.

faq.q: Is the tee rated for high temperatures?
faq.a: Yes, like all K-Aqua PP-R fittings, it is fully rated for continuous high-temperature hot water applications.

cross.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Cross fitting allows for the connection of four pipes of equal diameter at 90-degree angles, creating a highly efficient intersection.
cross.seo_p2: By using a single cross fitting instead of two offset tees, installers can save significant space, material, and welding time in complex layouts.
cross.seo_p3: It is particularly useful in grid-like distribution systems, underfloor heating manifolds, and industrial cooling networks where symmetrical branching is required.

faq.q: Does a cross fitting create more turbulence than a tee?
faq.a: Yes, the intersection of four flows can create more turbulence, so it is best used in systems where flow dynamics allow for it.

faq.q: Can I get a reducing cross?
faq.a: Standard crosses are usually equal. For reductions, reducing bushes can be welded into the branches of the cross.

faq.q: Is it as strong as a standard tee?
faq.a: Yes, the K-Aqua cross is reinforced at the intersection to handle the stress of four intersecting pipe runs safely.

cross-over.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Cross-Over fitting is an ingenious solution designed to cleanly route one pipe over another without causing a hydraulic bottleneck.
cross-over.seo_p2: Manufactured with a gentle, sweeping curve, this fitting maintains optimal flow rates while navigating intersecting pipe runs in tight spaces.
cross-over.seo_p3: It is frequently used in surface-mounted heating installations and complex manifold designs where pipes must cross paths securely and aesthetically.

faq.q: How is a cross-over installed?
faq.a: It is socket-fused at both ends into standard sockets or directly into other fittings, bridging over the intersecting pipe.

faq.q: Does the curve reduce the pressure rating?
faq.a: No, the wall thickness is precisely calculated to ensure it meets the full PN25 system pressure rating.

faq.q: Is there a risk of air entrapment in the curve?
faq.a: In closed heating systems, proper venting at the highest points is required to prevent air locks, especially when cross-overs are installed vertically.

cross-over-pipe.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Cross-Over Pipe offers an extended bridging solution for routing pipes over multiple intersecting lines or larger obstacles.
cross-over-pipe.seo_p2: Similar to the standard cross-over fitting but with longer straight sections on either side of the curve, it provides maximum flexibility during installation.
cross-over-pipe.seo_p3: This component is essential for neat, professional-looking surface installations in plant rooms and industrial facilities where multiple pipe tracks cross.

faq.q: What is the difference between this and the standard cross-over?
faq.a: The cross-over pipe has longer unformed ends, allowing it to be cut to the exact required length on site before fusion.

faq.q: Can it be used for both hot and cold water?
faq.a: Yes, it is made of premium PP-R and is fully suitable for all sanitary and heating applications.

faq.q: Does it require special support?
faq.a: Like any pipe run, it should be adequately supported with pipe clamps according to K-Aqua's installation guidelines.

adaptor-socket-female-thread.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Adaptor Socket with Female Thread provides a robust transition from the PP-R piping system to standard threaded metal components.
adaptor-socket-female-thread.seo_p2: Featuring a high-quality, dezincification-resistant (DZR) brass insert molded permanently into the PP-R matrix, it ensures a secure, leak-proof connection.
adaptor-socket-female-thread.seo_p3: It is the standard fitting for connecting PP-R pipes to threaded valves, pumps, water meters, and traditional metal piping systems.

faq.q: Can the brass insert come loose over time?
faq.a: No, the brass insert features a special knurled profile that is over-molded with PP-R, making it torsion-proof and permanently fixed.

faq.q: What type of thread is used?
faq.a: We use standard parallel or tapered pipe threads (BSP/NPT) depending on the regional market requirements.

faq.q: Do I need thread sealant?
faq.a: Yes, standard thread sealing materials like Teflon tape (PTFE) or hemp with joining compound should be used on the metal threads.

adaptor-socket-male-thread.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Adaptor Socket with Male Thread is the reliable counterpart for connecting female-threaded metal components to the PP-R network.
adaptor-socket-male-thread.seo_p2: Like its female equivalent, it utilizes a premium DZR brass insert that is deeply anchored in the PP-R body to withstand high torque during installation.
adaptor-socket-male-thread.seo_p3: This fitting is crucial for transitioning to threaded equipment, manifolds, and fixtures without compromising the system's structural integrity.

faq.q: Is the male thread prone to corrosion?
faq.a: No, we use high-grade dezincification-resistant brass which provides excellent corrosion resistance even in aggressive water conditions.

faq.q: How much torque can the fitting handle?
faq.a: The over-molded design is extremely robust, but installers should always use standard plumbing wrenches and avoid excessive, unnecessary force.

faq.q: Can it be used for heating systems?
faq.a: Yes, the brass-to-PP-R connection is engineered to easily handle the thermal expansion cycles of heating systems.

elbow-90-male-thread.seo_p1: The K-Aqua 90° Elbow with Male Thread combines a directional change with a transition to metal threads in a single, compact fitting.
elbow-90-male-thread.seo_p2: This eliminates the need for a separate elbow and threaded adaptor, saving space and reducing the number of weld joints by 50%.
elbow-90-male-thread.seo_p3: It is the ideal solution for connecting angle valves, radiators, and specific industrial machinery directly from a pipe run.

faq.q: Is the brass insert securely anchored?
faq.a: Yes, the metal insert is molded directly into the fitting's body, providing exceptional resistance against torsional stress.

faq.q: Can this be installed in a wall chase?
faq.a: Yes, it is fully suitable for concealed installations, provided standard pressure testing is performed before closing the wall.

faq.q: Does the elbow restrict flow?
faq.a: The internal geometry is optimized to ensure a smooth transition from the PP-R section into the brass insert.

elbow-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p1: The K-Aqua 90° Elbow Bracket with Female Thread (Wall Plate Elbow) is specifically designed for secure, rigid mounting of fixtures on walls.
elbow-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p2: It features an integrated mounting bracket with pre-drilled holes, allowing it to be screwed directly to masonry or drywall framework.
elbow-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p3: This fitting is the absolute standard for installing shower mixers, bath taps, and washing machine connections securely behind or on the wall.

faq.q: Why is the mounting bracket important?
faq.a: It absorbs the mechanical stress of operating the tap or valve, preventing that stress from being transferred to the PP-R pipe.

faq.q: Are the screw holes standardized?
faq.a: Yes, the holes are positioned to accommodate standard plumbing screws and rawlplugs.

faq.q: Does it have a DZR brass insert?
faq.a: Yes, the female thread is made from premium dezincification-resistant brass for maximum longevity.

elbowwall-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Wall Bracket Elbow 90° provides a specialized mounting solution for concealed plumbing installations requiring precise alignment.
elbowwall-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p2: Designed to be mounted on standardized installation tracks or brackets, it ensures exact spacing for dual-fixture connections like shower mixers.
elbowwall-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p3: This is the preferred fitting for high-volume residential projects and hotels where rapid, perfectly aligned sanitary installations are demanded.

faq.q: Can this be used with standard installation rails?
faq.a: Yes, the mounting geometry is designed to be compatible with common sanitary installation systems.

faq.q: Is the fitting sound-insulated?
faq.a: While the PP-R body itself dampens sound, acoustic decoupling sets (rubber inserts) are recommended when mounting to masonry.

faq.q: How much pressure can the female thread take?
faq.a: It easily withstands standard tap connection torques and system pressures up to PN25.

metal-union-male-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Metal Union with Male Thread (Yellow Brass) provides a high-strength, demountable connection for heavy-duty applications.
metal-union-male-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p2: Combining a PP-R weld socket with a solid brass union nut and male thread, it allows equipment to be easily disconnected without cutting the pipe.
metal-union-male-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p3: Ideal for installing pumps, heat exchangers, and large valves that require periodic maintenance or replacement.

faq.q: How is the seal achieved in this union?
faq.a: The union uses a high-quality flat gasket (usually EPDM) compressed by the brass nut to create a leak-proof seal.

faq.q: Why use yellow brass?
faq.a: Yellow brass provides excellent tensile strength and durability for the union nut, ensuring it won't crack under high tightening torque.

faq.q: Can the union be reused after maintenance?
faq.a: The brass components are fully reusable, though it is recommended to replace the flat gasket whenever the union is opened.

metal-union-female-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Metal Union with Female Thread (Yellow Brass) offers a secure, separable connection point to male-threaded equipment.
metal-union-female-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p2: This robust fitting features a heavy-duty brass union nut that facilitates rapid disconnection of components in complex plumbing systems.
metal-union-female-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p3: It is extensively used in boiler rooms, manifold assemblies, and industrial fluid transport systems where accessibility is paramount.

faq.q: What is the advantage of a union over a standard threaded adaptor?
faq.a: A union allows you to disconnect the pipe from the equipment without having to rotate the equipment or the pipe itself.

faq.q: Is it suitable for high-temperature hot water?
faq.a: Yes, the PP-R body, brass components, and standard EPDM gaskets are rated for high-temperature heating applications.

faq.q: How tight should the union nut be?
faq.a: It should be tightened firmly with a wrench to compress the gasket, but overtightening should be avoided to prevent gasket damage.

metal-union-male-thread.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Metal Union with Male Thread features premium DZR brass components for maximum corrosion resistance in aggressive water conditions.
metal-union-male-thread.seo_p2: Designed for critical applications, this separable fitting guarantees long-term structural integrity and easy maintenance access.
metal-union-male-thread.seo_p3: It is the premium choice for hospital networks, highly regulated drinking water systems, and aggressive industrial cooling circuits.

faq.q: What is DZR brass?
faq.a: DZR stands for Dezincification Resistant. It prevents the brass from degrading in specific aggressive water chemistries.

faq.q: Does this union require thread sealant?
faq.a: The male threads connecting to the equipment require sealant, but the union interface itself relies on the included flat gasket.

faq.q: Is it certified for drinking water?
faq.a: Yes, all materials used in this union strictly comply with international drinking water standards.

metal-union-female-thread.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Metal Union with Female Thread (DZR Brass) is the ultimate separable connector for connecting to male-threaded devices.
metal-union-female-thread.seo_p2: With its dezincification-resistant brass construction, it ensures absolute safety against corrosion-induced failure, even after decades of service.
metal-union-female-thread.seo_p3: Perfect for connecting premium water meters, pressure reducing valves, and high-end sanitary manifolds in commercial infrastructure.

faq.q: Can this be installed in hidden shafts?
faq.a: While unions are highly reliable, best practice dictates that all mechanical/separable joints should remain accessible for maintenance.

faq.q: How does it connect to the PP-R pipe?
faq.a: The tailpiece of the union is made of PP-R and is socket-fused to the pipe just like a standard fitting.

faq.q: Are replacement gaskets available?
faq.a: Yes, standard EPDM flat gaskets are readily available through K-Aqua distributors.

tee-90-male-thread.seo_p1: The K-Aqua 90° Tee with Male Thread provides a perpendicular threaded branch off a main PP-R pipe run.
tee-90-male-thread.seo_p2: By integrating a DZR brass male thread into the branch of the tee, this fitting eliminates the need for a separate tee and threaded adaptor.
tee-90-male-thread.seo_p3: It is an incredibly efficient solution for installing sensors, drain valves, or connecting specialized machinery directly to the main line.

faq.q: Is the main run of the tee PP-R on both sides?
faq.a: Yes, the main straight run has standard PP-R sockets for welding, while the 90° branch features the brass thread.

faq.q: Can it withstand high torque on the branch?
faq.a: The brass insert is deeply molded into the PP-R matrix, making it highly resistant to torsional forces during installation.

faq.q: Is the internal flow restricted?
faq.a: The tee is hydrodynamically optimized to ensure smooth flow both through the main run and into the branch.

tee-90-female-thread.seo_p1: The K-Aqua 90° Tee with Female Thread offers a secure, perpendicular female threaded connection directly from the main pipeline.
tee-90-female-thread.seo_p2: This fitting is essential for mounting pressure gauges, thermometers, or creating drop-down connections to threaded fixtures.
tee-90-female-thread.seo_p3: Featuring our signature over-molded DZR brass insert, it guarantees a leak-proof and torsion-resistant connection for decades.

faq.q: Can I screw a valve directly into this tee?
faq.a: Yes, it is perfect for installing angle valves or isolation valves directly off a distribution line.

faq.q: Does the metal insert come into contact with the water?
faq.a: Yes, but because it is made of premium DZR brass, it perfectly maintains drinking water hygiene.

faq.q: Is this tee available in large dimensions?
faq.a: It is available in a wide range of sizes, typically branching off mains up to 125mm down to standard thread sizes.

union.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Plastic Union is an all-PP-R separable fitting designed to allow disconnection of pipe sections without metallic components.
union.seo_p2: This fitting provides a highly chemically resistant, demountable joint, utilizing a plastic union nut and a robust flat gasket.
union.seo_p3: It is particularly favoured in industrial fluid transport and chemical processing where metal components might be susceptible to aggressive media.

faq.q: Is the plastic union nut as strong as a brass one?
faq.a: It is engineered with thick PP-R walls to withstand the system's rated pressure, though it requires less tightening torque than metal.

faq.q: Can it be used for drinking water?
faq.a: Yes, being 100% PP-R, it is fully certified for hygienic drinking water applications.

faq.q: Do I need special tools to tighten it?
faq.a: A standard strap wrench or plastic-jawed wrench is recommended to avoid gouging the plastic nut.

union-for-watermeters.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Union for Water Meters is specifically designed to facilitate the rapid, secure installation and replacement of standard water meters.
union-for-watermeters.seo_p2: It features a brass union nut with a hole for security sealing (lead sealing), complying with municipal and utility regulations.
union-for-watermeters.seo_p3: This is an indispensable fitting for residential intakes and apartment manifolds, ensuring a tamper-proof yet easily serviceable meter connection.

faq.q: Why is there a hole in the union nut?
faq.a: The hole allows utility companies to pass a sealing wire through it, proving the meter has not been tampered with.

faq.q: Does it fit all water meters?
faq.a: It is designed with standard threads (e.g., 3/4" or 1") to fit the vast majority of residential water meters.

faq.q: Does it include the gasket?
faq.a: Yes, it is typically supplied with a high-quality EPDM flat gasket required for a reliable seal against the meter body.

pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-pp.seo_p1: The K-Aqua PP-R Ball Valve with PP Ball offers a completely metal-free flow control solution, perfect for aggressive environments.
pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-pp.seo_p2: Both the valve body and the internal ball are crafted from high-performance PP-R, ensuring absolute chemical resistance and zero corrosion.
pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-pp.seo_p3: It is widely used in chemical plants, desalination facilities, and specialized agricultural systems where metal valves would quickly degrade.

faq.q: How does a plastic ball seal effectively?
faq.a: The PP ball is precision-machined and sits between high-grade Teflon (PTFE) seats, ensuring a smooth, tight seal.

faq.q: Is it suitable for high temperatures?
faq.a: It performs excellently within the standard PP-R temperature range, though metal ball valves are preferred for extreme high-temperature heating.

faq.q: Can the valve be serviced?
faq.a: It is designed as a robust, maintenance-free unit. In the rare event of failure, the entire valve is typically replaced.

pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-brass-chromium-p.seo_p1: The K-Aqua PP-R Ball Valve with Chrome-Plated Brass Ball is our premium isolation valve for drinking water and heating systems.
pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-brass-chromium-p.seo_p2: It combines the weldability of a PP-R body with the extreme mechanical durability and smooth operation of a chrome-plated brass ball.
pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-brass-chromium-p.seo_p3: This valve provides full-bore flow with zero pressure loss and guarantees decades of reliable operation in residential and commercial infrastructure.

faq.q: Why use a brass ball instead of plastic?
faq.a: The chrome-plated brass ball offers superior resistance to scratching from particulates in the water and handles higher thermal stress.

faq.q: Is the flow restricted?
faq.a: No, this is a full-bore valve. The hole in the ball matches the internal diameter of the pipe, causing zero flow restriction.

faq.q: Is it safe for drinking water?
faq.a: Yes, the chrome plating over DZR brass meets all international hygiene standards for potable water.

tee-90-female-thread-for-internal-valve.seo_p1: The K-Aqua 90° Tee for Internal Valve is a specialized manifold fitting designed to house concealed stop valves directly within the pipe run.
tee-90-female-thread-for-internal-valve.seo_p2: This highly specific fitting allows for the seamless integration of shut-off mechanisms in tight wall cavities without bulky external valves.
tee-90-female-thread-for-internal-valve.seo_p3: It is an elegant, space-saving solution heavily favoured by architects for high-end bathroom installations and hotel sanitary manifolds.

faq.q: What kind of valve goes into this tee?
faq.a: It is designed to accept standard concealed valve upper parts (spindles), which screw directly into the brass female thread.

faq.q: Can this be plastered over?
faq.a: The tee itself is concealed in the wall, while the valve spindle protrudes through the tiles, covered by a decorative rosette.

faq.q: Is the brass insert replaceable?
faq.a: No, the brass body is permanently molded into the PP-R tee, ensuring maximum strength and leak prevention.

concealed-valve-chrome-light-part.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Concealed Valve (Light Chrome Part) is a sleek, minimalist shut-off valve designed for visible mounting over concealed pipework.
concealed-valve-chrome-light-part.seo_p2: Featuring a high-quality chrome finish and a streamlined handle design, it blends perfectly into modern bathroom and kitchen aesthetics.
concealed-valve-chrome-light-part.seo_p3: It provides reliable isolation for individual fixtures like toilets, washing machines, and sinks without disrupting the room's visual harmony.

faq.q: What does 'Light Part' mean?
faq.a: It refers to the streamlined, minimalist design of the handle and rosette, as opposed to heavy-duty industrial handles.

faq.q: Is the internal mechanism durable?
faq.a: Yes, it uses a premium brass spindle with high-grade rubber or ceramic seals for decades of drip-free operation.

faq.q: How is it installed?
faq.a: The PP-R body is welded into the pipe run inside the wall, and the chrome handle assembly is attached after tiling.

concealed-valve-chrome-heavy-part.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Concealed Valve (Heavy Chrome Part) is a robust, heavy-duty isolation valve designed for high-traffic and commercial environments.
concealed-valve-chrome-heavy-part.seo_p2: It features a more substantial, highly durable chrome handle and rosette, designed to withstand frequent use in public restrooms and hotels.
concealed-valve-chrome-heavy-part.seo_p3: Combining extreme mechanical durability with a premium aesthetic finish, it is the ultimate choice for uncompromising commercial sanitary design.

faq.q: How does it differ from the 'Light' version?
faq.a: The 'Heavy' version features a thicker, more robust handle and internal spindle designed for higher mechanical abuse.

faq.q: Can the chrome parts be replaced if damaged?
faq.a: Yes, the external chrome handle and rosette can be unscrewed and replaced without opening the wall.

faq.q: Is it suitable for high water pressure?
faq.a: Absolutely, the valve body and mechanism are rated for PN25, handling massive pressure spikes with ease.

straight-seat-valve-upper-part-green-han.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Straight Seat Valve Upper Part with Green Handle is a highly durable valve mechanism designed for precise flow control in exposed pipework.
straight-seat-valve-upper-part-green-han.seo_p2: The characteristic green handle allows for easy identification in complex plant rooms, and the robust brass spindle ensures fine control over water flow.
straight-seat-valve-upper-part-green-han.seo_p3: Typically installed in main distribution headers and utility rooms, it provides reliable isolation and throttling capabilities for heating and water circuits.

faq.q: What does a 'straight seat' valve do?
faq.a: Unlike a ball valve, a straight seat valve forces the water through an internal baffle, allowing for precise flow regulation (throttling) rather than just on/off action.

faq.q: Why is the handle green?
faq.a: The green colour is often used for visual coding, indicating cold water or specific utility lines in industrial environments.

faq.q: Can the seal be replaced?
faq.a: Yes, the internal rubber or EPDM washer can be replaced if it wears out, without removing the valve body from the pipe.

elongation-pieces.seo_p1: K-Aqua Elongation Pieces are essential brass extensions used to adjust the depth of wall-mounted fittings before final fixture installation.
elongation-pieces.seo_p2: If a concealed fitting is set too deeply within the plaster or tile, these threaded extensions bridge the gap to ensure a perfect connection for the tap.
elongation-pieces.seo_p3: They are a lifesaver for installers dealing with uneven wall finishes or thicker-than-expected tiling layers.

faq.q: What thread sizes do they have?
faq.a: They typically feature standard 1/2" or 3/4" male to female threads to match common sanitary fixtures.

faq.q: Are they made of DZR brass?
faq.a: Yes, to maintain the integrity of the drinking water system, they are manufactured from high-quality, corrosion-resistant brass.

faq.q: Can multiple pieces be stacked?
faq.a: While technically possible, it is best practice to use a single elongation piece of the correct length to minimize threaded joints.

battery-female-thread.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Battery with Female Thread is a pre-assembled, rigid mounting plate featuring two perfectly spaced female threaded elbows.
battery-female-thread.seo_p2: Designed for standard wall-mounted bath or shower mixers, it guarantees the exact 150mm centre-to-centre distance required for flawless tap installation.
battery-female-thread.seo_p3: This one-piece bracket eliminates alignment errors during rough-in, saving immense time and preventing costly rework after tiling.

faq.q: Is the spacing fixed?
faq.a: Yes, this model has a fixed spacing, usually 150mm, which is the international standard for most shower and bath mixers.

faq.q: How is it secured to the wall?
faq.a: The integrated polymer bracket features multiple mounting holes for robust fixation to studs or masonry.

faq.q: Does it include sound insulation?
faq.a: The robust polymer bracket naturally dampens acoustic transmission, reducing water noise in the adjacent room.

adjustable-battery-female-thread.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Adjustable Battery offers flexible centre-to-centre spacing for specialized or non-standard sanitary fixtures.
adjustable-battery-female-thread.seo_p2: Featuring movable threaded elbows on a slotted mounting track, installers can precisely dial in the required distance before locking it down.
adjustable-battery-female-thread.seo_p3: This is perfect for retrofitting older buildings with non-standard plumbing centres or installing unique designer tapware.

faq.q: What is the adjustment range?
faq.a: It typically allows adjustment from very narrow spacing up to wider custom configurations, accommodating almost any mixer type.

faq.q: Does it lock securely?
faq.a: Yes, once the correct spacing is set, locking nuts or screws secure the elbows firmly to the track to prevent movement during use.

faq.q: Is it as strong as the fixed battery?
faq.a: When properly tightened and mounted to the wall structure, it provides a highly rigid and secure connection.

weld-in-saddle.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Weld-in Saddle provides a revolutionary method for creating branch connections on existing pipe runs without cutting the main pipe.
weld-in-saddle.seo_p2: By drilling a hole in the main pipe and welding the saddle directly over it, installers save significant time and maintain the main pipe's structural integrity.
weld-in-saddle.seo_p3: This technique is incredibly efficient for adding new distribution lines, sprinkler drops, or sensors to large diameter industrial and commercial mains.

faq.q: How do you weld it to the pipe?
faq.a: A specialized saddle welding tool is used, which heats both the outer wall of the pipe and the inner curve of the saddle simultaneously.

faq.q: Is the connection rated for high pressure?
faq.a: Yes, once fused, the saddle becomes a monolithic part of the pipe wall, fully capable of withstanding the system's PN rating.

faq.q: Can I use it on small pipes?
faq.a: Saddles are generally designed for branching off medium to large pipes (e.g., 40mm and above) where standard tees are bulky or expensive.

weld-in-saddle-female-thread.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Weld-in Saddle with Female Thread allows for the direct installation of threaded components onto an active pipe run.
weld-in-saddle-female-thread.seo_p2: Integrating our robust DZR brass female thread into the saddle base, it provides an immediate threaded port after drilling and welding.
weld-in-saddle-female-thread.seo_p3: It is the optimal solution for retrofitting pressure gauges, temperature sensors, or drain valves onto large district heating or cooling mains.

faq.q: Do I need a special drill?
faq.a: Yes, a specialized PP-R hole saw or stepped drill bit is used to create a clean hole without dropping plastic shavings into the pipe.

faq.q: Can it be welded while the pipe is full?
faq.a: No, standard saddle fusion requires the pipe to be drained and dry at the point of welding to ensure proper heat transfer.

faq.q: Is the brass insert secure?
faq.a: Yes, the female thread is permanently over-molded into the PP-R saddle, resisting high torsional forces.

weld-in-saddle-male-thread.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Weld-in Saddle with Male Thread offers a direct male threaded connection point branched off a larger pipeline.
weld-in-saddle-male-thread.seo_p2: This eliminates the need to weld a standard saddle, followed by a piece of pipe, followed by a male threaded adaptor.
weld-in-saddle-male-thread.seo_p3: Perfect for connecting flexible hoses, female-threaded valves, or specific industrial equipment rapidly and securely to the main line.

faq.q: Is it made of DZR brass?
faq.a: Yes, like all our threaded fittings, the male thread is made of premium dezincification-resistant brass.

faq.q: How long does the installation take?
faq.a: Drilling and fusing a saddle takes a fraction of the time compared to cutting the pipe and installing a large reducing tee.

faq.q: What is the maximum branch size?
faq.a: Saddles are available in various sizes, but the branch diameter is always significantly smaller than the main pipe diameter.

pipe-clamps.seo_p1: K-Aqua Pipe Clamps are engineered to securely support PP-R pipelines while accommodating their natural thermal expansion and contraction.
pipe-clamps.seo_p2: Lined with high-quality acoustic rubber, these steel clamps reduce vibration transmission, ensuring whisper-quiet operation in residential buildings.
pipe-clamps.seo_p3: Properly spaced clamps are critical to preventing pipe sag and managing the linear forces generated in high-temperature heating systems.

faq.q: Should I tighten the clamp completely?
faq.a: For 'sliding points', the clamp should be snug but allow the pipe to slide axially. For 'fixed points', the clamp must grip the pipe tightly to prevent any movement.

faq.q: Why is the rubber lining important?
faq.a: It dampens acoustic vibrations (water hammer) and prevents the steel clamp from physically abrading the plastic pipe during thermal movement.

faq.q: How far apart should they be placed?
faq.a: Clamp spacing depends on the pipe diameter and operating temperature. Refer to the K-Aqua technical manual for specific spacing tables.

backing-flange-pp-steel-sfbf.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Backing Flange (PP-Steel) provides the mechanical strength required to bolt a PP-R flange adaptor to metal equipment.
backing-flange-pp-steel-sfbf.seo_p2: Constructed with a solid steel core encased in durable Polypropylene (PP), it offers immense clamping force while being 100% immune to external corrosion.
backing-flange-pp-steel-sfbf.seo_p3: This is the ultimate flange ring for harsh environments, such as chemical plants, marine applications, or damp plant rooms.

faq.q: Why is the steel coated in plastic?
faq.a: The PP coating protects the structural steel core from rust, ensuring the flange remains structurally sound and easy to unbolt even after years in a damp environment.

faq.q: Does it fit standard metal flanges?
faq.a: Yes, the bolt hole patterns are manufactured to match international flange standards (e.g., DIN/EN, ANSI).

faq.q: How tight should the bolts be?
faq.a: Bolts should be tightened in a cross-pattern to the specific torque recommended for the gasket being used.

flat-gasket.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Flat Gasket is the essential sealing element for all flanged connections within the piping network.
flat-gasket.seo_p2: Made from high-grade EPDM or suitable elastomers, it compresses perfectly between the PP-R flange adaptor and the mating metal flange.
flat-gasket.seo_p3: It ensures a completely leak-free seal capable of withstanding the system's maximum pressure and temperature variations.

faq.q: Can I reuse a flat gasket?
faq.a: It is highly recommended to replace the flat gasket every time a flanged connection is unbolted to guarantee a perfect seal.

faq.q: Is EPDM suitable for drinking water?
faq.a: Yes, our standard EPDM gaskets are fully certified for use with potable water and are highly resistant to standard water treatment chemicals.

faq.q: Can I use standard rubber?
faq.a: No, standard rubber degrades quickly under high temperatures. Always use specified EPDM or PTFE gaskets for heating and industrial use.

flat-gasket-for-unions-pp-r.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Flat Gasket for Unions is a precision-cut sealing ring designed specifically for our brass and plastic union fittings.
flat-gasket-for-unions-pp-r.seo_p2: Manufactured to exact tolerances, it sits perfectly within the union seat, providing a watertight seal when the union nut is tightened.
flat-gasket-for-unions-pp-r.seo_p3: This high-performance EPDM gasket absorbs mechanical vibrations and thermal micro-movements, ensuring long-term reliability in separable connections.

faq.q: Why is this different from a flange gasket?
faq.a: It is dimensionally smaller and specifically profiled to fit inside the tight confines of a union fitting.

faq.q: Do I need sealing paste as well?
faq.a: No, the flat gasket provides a complete seal on its own. Sealing paste or Teflon tape should NEVER be used on the flat mating surfaces of a union.

faq.q: What happens if I overtighten it?
faq.a: Overtightening can crush or tear the gasket, leading to leaks. Tighten firmly, but respect the material's compression limits.

plug.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Threaded Plug provides a temporary or permanent seal for any female-threaded fitting or manifold port.
plug.seo_p2: Manufactured from durable PP-R or brass, it safely caps off unused branches during pressure testing or before final fixture installation.
plug.seo_p3: An essential component for every installer's toolkit, ensuring safe, leak-free isolation of open threaded connections.

faq.q: Does it require thread sealant?
faq.a: Yes, like all threaded connections, it requires Teflon tape or a suitable thread sealing compound to ensure a watertight seal.

faq.q: Can it be left in permanently?
faq.a: Yes, it is rated for the full system pressure and can serve as a permanent cap for unused branches.

faq.q: Is there a risk of it blowing out?
faq.a: When properly threaded and sealed, it is as secure as any connected valve or pipe.

pipe-cutter-2040.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Pipe Cutter (20-40mm) is a professional-grade hand tool essential for achieving perfectly clean, square cuts on smaller PP-R pipes.
pipe-cutter-2040.seo_p2: Featuring a ratcheting mechanism and a razor-sharp, hardened steel blade, it slices through PP-R effortlessly without deforming the pipe.
pipe-cutter-2040.seo_p3: A clean, square cut is the critical first step to a perfect socket fusion weld, making this tool indispensable for residential and commercial installers.

faq.q: Why can't I just use a hacksaw?
faq.a: A hacksaw leaves rough edges, burrs, and is rarely perfectly square. These imperfections can ruin the integrity of the welded joint.

faq.q: Does it work on fibre-reinforced pipes?
faq.a: Yes, the hardened blade cuts through our standard and fibre-reinforced PP-R pipes with ease.

faq.q: Can the blade be replaced?
faq.a: Yes, replacement blades are available. A sharp blade is vital for safe and clean cuts.

pipe-cutter-50125.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Rotary Pipe Cutter (50-125mm) is designed for precision cutting of medium to large diameter PP-R and composite pipes.
pipe-cutter-50125.seo_p2: This rotary style cutter uses a sharp cutting wheel that scores and cuts through the thick walls of large pipes as the tool is rotated around the pipe.
pipe-cutter-50125.seo_p3: It guarantees an absolutely square cut on large industrial mains, which is critical for electrofusion and butt-welding preparation.

faq.q: How does it work?
faq.a: The tool is clamped around the pipe, and the handle is tightened slightly after each rotation, driving the cutting wheel through the pipe wall.

faq.q: Does it leave burrs?
faq.a: It leaves a very clean edge, but installers should still inspect and lightly chamfer the inner edge if necessary before welding.

faq.q: Is it heavy to use?
faq.a: It requires physical space to rotate around the pipe, but the leverage provided by the tool makes the cutting process manageable.

pipe-cutter-50125-1.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Guillotine Pipe Cutter (50-125mm) is an alternative heavy-duty cutting tool for rapid sectioning of large PP-R pipes.
pipe-cutter-50125-1.seo_p2: Using a powerful ratcheting guillotine blade, it provides a fast, straight cut without the need to rotate the tool entirely around the pipe.
pipe-cutter-50125-1.seo_p3: This is especially useful in confined trenches or tight ceiling spaces where a rotary cutter cannot swing a full 360 degrees.

faq.q: Does the guillotine deform the pipe?
faq.a: High-quality guillotine cutters are designed with a V-shaped cradle to support the pipe and prevent ovalization during the cut.

faq.q: Is it faster than the rotary cutter?
faq.a: Yes, it is generally much faster, making it ideal for high-volume demolition or rough cutting.

faq.q: Can it cut fibre pipes?
faq.a: Yes, it cleanly slices through all K-Aqua PP-R and PPRCT fibre composite pipes.

hand-welding-machine-2032-complete-set.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Hand Welding Machine (20-32mm) Complete Set provides everything needed to fuse small-diameter PP-R pipes professionally.
hand-welding-machine-2032-complete-set.seo_p2: The set includes a precision electronically controlled heating iron, Teflon-coated heating sockets (20, 25, 32mm), a stand, and a rugged carrying case.
hand-welding-machine-2032-complete-set.seo_p3: This lightweight, highly maneuverable tool is the everyday workhorse for residential plumbers and tight-space installations.

faq.q: How accurate is the temperature control?
faq.a: It features an electronic thermostat that maintains the exact 260°C required for perfect PP-R fusion.

faq.q: How long do the Teflon coatings last?
faq.a: With proper care (cleaning only with non-abrasive materials), the premium PTFE coating lasts for hundreds of welds.

faq.q: Can I weld 40mm pipes with this?
faq.a: While the heating element might handle the load, this specific small machine is optimized and supplied with dies up to 32mm.

hand-welding-machine-2063-complete-set.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Hand Welding Machine (20-63mm) Complete Set is the most versatile fusion tool for commercial and residential contractors.
hand-welding-machine-2063-complete-set.seo_p2: Featuring a larger heating plate and high wattage, it provides the thermal mass needed to quickly heat sockets up to 63mm without temperature drop.
hand-welding-machine-2063-complete-set.seo_p3: Supplied with a full range of non-stick welding dies, it covers 90% of all standard plumbing and heating dimensions in a single kit.

faq.q: Is it much heavier than the smaller version?
faq.a: It is slightly heavier due to the larger heating plate, but remains highly portable and easy to use by a single installer.

faq.q: Does it have a stand?
faq.a: Yes, it includes a sturdy floor stand and a table clamp, allowing for easy bench-top pre-fabrication.

faq.q: What happens if the temperature drops during welding?
faq.a: The high wattage ensures rapid recovery, but a built-in indicator light tells the operator exactly when it's safe to weld.

hand-welding-machine-mirror-50125.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Mirror Welding Machine (50-125mm) is a specialized heating tool for large diameter socket fusion.
hand-welding-machine-mirror-50125.seo_p2: Designed with a massive, flat 'mirror' heating plate, it accommodates the large welding dies required for 50mm to 125mm pipes.
hand-welding-machine-mirror-50125.seo_p3: This high-capacity tool ensures even heat distribution across large surface areas, critical for the structural integrity of industrial mains and risers.

faq.q: Can one person use this tool?
faq.a: Due to the size of the pipes and the force required to push 125mm fittings together, large diameter welding typically requires a two-man crew or a bench-mounted welding jig.

faq.q: Are the heating dies included?
faq.a: Dies are often selected and attached based on the specific job requirements, utilizing the large flat surface of the mirror.

faq.q: Is the temperature adjustable?
faq.a: Yes, highly precise digital or analog controls maintain the critical 260°C across the entire large heating surface.

welding-tool.seo_p1: K-Aqua Welding Tools (Heating Dies) are precision-engineered, Teflon-coated attachments that transfer heat from the machine to the pipe and fitting.
welding-tool.seo_p2: Consisting of a male mandrel (for the fitting socket) and a female sleeve (for the pipe exterior), they ensure exact melting depths and profiles.
welding-tool.seo_p3: Available in all sizes matching the K-Aqua pipe range, the quality of these dies directly dictates the quality of the final welded joint.

faq.q: Why is the Teflon coating so important?
faq.a: It prevents the melted PP-R plastic from sticking to the metal tool, ensuring a clean release and a perfect weld geometry.

faq.q: How should I clean them?
faq.a: Clean them only when hot, using a clean, lint-free cotton cloth. Never use wire brushes or abrasive materials that will destroy the coating.

faq.q: When should they be replaced?
faq.a: Replace the dies immediately if the Teflon coating is severely scratched or if plastic begins sticking to them continuously.

welding-machine-50125-complete-set.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Bench Welding Machine (50-125mm) Complete Set provides mechanical assistance for fusing large diameter pipes.
welding-machine-50125-complete-set.seo_p2: Because pushing together large pipes (e.g., 90mm or 110mm) requires immense physical force, this machine uses a geared track to align and drive the pipe into the fitting.
welding-machine-50125-complete-set.seo_p3: It guarantees perfect axial alignment and insertion depth, making it indispensable for prefabricated manifolds and large commercial installations.

faq.q: Does this tool use socket fusion or butt fusion?
faq.a: This specific machine is designed for mechanically assisted *socket fusion* using standard PP-R fittings and heating dies.

faq.q: Can it be used on-site?
faq.a: Yes, while it acts as a bench tool, it is portable enough to be set up on a construction site for local prefabrication.

faq.q: Does it prevent the pipe from going in too deep?
faq.a: Yes, mechanical stops and alignment clamps ensure the pipe is inserted to the exact depth required for a perfect weld.

butt-welding-machine-90250.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Butt-Welding Machine (90-250mm) is the ultimate heavy-duty hydraulic tool for jointing massive industrial PP-R pipelines.
butt-welding-machine-90250.seo_p2: Instead of using fittings, butt-welding joins the ends of two pipes directly together under high hydraulic pressure after facing and heating.
butt-welding-machine-90250.seo_p3: This machine includes a hydraulic clamping chassis, a motorized facing tool (planer), and a highly accurate heating mirror, perfect for infrastructure projects.

faq.q: Do I need fittings for butt-welding?
faq.a: For straight joints, no fittings are needed. The pipes are fused directly end-to-end. Specialized butt-weld elbows and tees are used for directional changes.

faq.q: Is butt-welding stronger than socket fusion?
faq.a: When performed correctly according to DVS guidelines, a butt-weld has the exact same strength and pressure rating as the pipe itself.

faq.q: Does it create an internal bead?
faq.a: Yes, the process creates a characteristic double bead both inside and outside the pipe, which is an indicator of a good weld.

electrofusion-machine.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Electrofusion Machine is a computerized power supply unit required for welding electrofusion sockets and large fittings.
electrofusion-machine.seo_p2: It reads a barcode on the fitting to automatically determine the exact voltage and welding time required for a perfect fusion.
electrofusion-machine.seo_p3: Essential for repair work in trenches, high-density pipe shafts, and any situation where manual socket fusion tools cannot physically reach.

faq.q: How does it know the welding parameters?
faq.a: The operator uses an attached barcode scanner to read the label on the electrofusion fitting, and the machine programs itself automatically.

faq.q: Does it record the welds?
faq.a: Yes, professional machines store a digital log of every weld performed, which can be downloaded for quality assurance documentation.

faq.q: Is the pipe preparation different?
faq.a: Yes, the pipe *must* be scraped (oxidized layer removed) and cleaned with specific solvent wipes before electrofusion.

welding-tool-for-weld-in-saddles.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Saddle Welding Tool is a specialized heating die set designed exclusively for fusing weld-in saddles to main pipes.
welding-tool-for-weld-in-saddles.seo_p2: The female side has a concave curve to heat the outer wall of the main pipe, while the male side heats the saddle's base and spigot simultaneously.
welding-tool-for-weld-in-saddles.seo_p3: This precision tool ensures that the exact required geometry of plastic is melted, guaranteeing a flawless, high-pressure branch connection.

faq.q: Can I use standard dies for this?
faq.a: No, standard dies are flat/cylindrical. Saddle dies are specifically curved to match the radius of the main pipe.

faq.q: Are there different sizes?
faq.a: Yes, you need a specific tool combination that matches both the main pipe diameter and the branch saddle diameter.

faq.q: Does it fit on a standard hand welding machine?
faq.a: Yes, the saddle dies bolt onto the standard flat heating plate of a K-Aqua hand welding machine.

drilling-tool-for-weld-in-saddle.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Saddle Drilling Tool is a specialized hole saw designed to safely bore through the wall of a PP-R pipe.
drilling-tool-for-weld-in-saddle.seo_p2: It is engineered to extract the plastic plug cleanly, preventing plastic shavings from falling into the pipeline and causing blockages downstream.
drilling-tool-for-weld-in-saddle.seo_p3: A critical preparatory tool that ensures the hole is the exact diameter required for the spigot of the weld-in saddle.

faq.q: Does it attach to a standard drill?
faq.a: Yes, the arbor fits into a standard power drill chuck.

faq.q: How does it stop shavings from falling in?
faq.a: The geometry of the teeth and the pilot bit are designed to hold the cut plastic 'puck' so it is pulled out with the tool.

faq.q: Can I just use a wood hole saw?
faq.a: No, standard hole saws can melt the plastic, create messy burrs, and drop debris into the critical fluid network.

welding-tool-for-repairing-plug.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Repair Tool is a lifesaver on site, designed to fix accidental punctures (e.g., from a drill bit) in concealed PP-R pipes.
welding-tool-for-repairing-plug.seo_p2: This specialized micro-die heats the punctured hole in the pipe while simultaneously heating a specialized PP-R repair plug.
welding-tool-for-repairing-plug.seo_p3: It allows plumbers to permanently seal a small leak in a wall without having to cut out the pipe and install a complex bypass.

faq.q: How big of a hole can it fix?
faq.a: It is designed specifically for small punctures, typically around 7mm to 11mm, such as those caused by masonry drill bits.

faq.q: Is the repair permanent?
faq.a: Yes, the plug fuses homogeneously with the pipe wall, restoring the pipe's full PN pressure rating permanently.

faq.q: Do I need to drain the pipe?
faq.a: Yes, the area must be completely dry and pressure-free for the fusion process to work.

repairing-plug.seo_p1: The K-Aqua Repairing Plug is a specialized PP-R rod used in conjunction with the repair tool to seal accidental punctures.
repairing-plug.seo_p2: Made from the same premium Polypropylene as the pipes, it melts and permanently fuses into the damaged hole, restoring system integrity.
repairing-plug.seo_p3: A fast, incredibly cost-effective solution to what is usually a highly destructive and expensive on-site accident.

faq.q: Do I just melt it with a lighter?
faq.a: No, it must be heated precisely with the K-Aqua repair welding tool to ensure a proper molecular bond.

faq.q: What do I do with the extra length of the plug?
faq.a: Once the weld has cooled, the protruding part of the plug is simply snipped off flush with the pipe.

faq.q: Can it fix a cracked pipe?
faq.a: No, it is only designed for clean punctures. Cracked or split pipes must have the damaged section cut out and replaced.

The marking links the physical product with its batch and the quality assurance test protocols. What is written on the pipe can be traced right back to the test laboratory, a building block of the QA manual that auditors can request in the Trust Centre.

posts.teaser: From flare gas to drinking water pipe: the brief material history of polypropylene.
body: Polypropylene is produced from gases that used to be pointlessly flared off. Material utilisation reduces air pollution at the source. As an engineering plastic, PP is unusually resistant to solvents, alkalis, and acids, and forms complex geometries in injection moulding.

In the pipe, the inner surface is what counts most: with 0.007 mm roughness, pressure loss remains minimal, biofilm and incrustation find hardly any hold. Add to this the thermal conductivity of 0.24 W/(m·K): warm water stays warm without the pipe insulating against itself.
PPRCT pushes the boundaries even further: the modified crystalline structure brings more temperature and pressure reserve. SDR 7.4 sustains 70 °C at 10 bar in continuous operation.

posts.t: Brass meets polypropylene: transitions to existing systems
posts.teaser: Renovation almost always means a system change: transition pieces with brass threads make it clean.
body: Hardly any project starts on a greenfield site: existing copper or galvanised steel pipes must be connected. For this purpose, there are transition pieces with embedded brass female or male threads: the thread side connects the existing metal, the PP side is welded with a material bond.

This allows renovation in sections: corroded branches are replaced, functioning ones remain, and the corrosion problem does not migrate into the new system. Screw connections make the joint detachable again if needed, for instance at valves and water meters.
